why: The load-bearing arm, and the one that looks like the other. `note` declares no edges: it has SAID NOTHING about what it may link to, which is not the same as licensing nothing. A server that returns an empty list without `declares_edges: false` lets a client read silence as a closed contract, and that client will report every instance in a corpus whose ontology is not filled in. The corpus carries this class for no other reason.
